body: When one language-model agent asks another for money, which of the two decides how much changes hands? We ran a round-robin tournament of 1,049 negotiations among fifteen agents. In each game a requester tries to raise money from a holder that has been told to keep a 100 endowment. Knowing which agent holds the money explains 47% of the variance in the amount transferred; knowing which agent asks explains 2%. Dropping the most extreme agents narrows the split to 22% against 4%. Changing the requester's appeal from one named person to a group changed what requesters wrote, but the amounts transferred under the two framings are statistically equivalent. The holders that lose least are the ones that turn down the opening request, and their turn-1 refusal rate ranks them by total losses (Spearman correlation = -0.73). Training moves this behaviour in both directions. Fine-tuning Qwen3-8B on a persuasion corpus with almost no refusals raised what it gave away as a holder from 12% to 84% of the endowment. Distilling two never-losing holders into a 4B student cut its losses from 95% to 1%. Evaluations of agents that hold resources should test them in the holder role, including after persuasion fine-tuning.
summaryZh: 本文通过对15个智能体进行1,049场谈判博弈，探讨了智能体在资源分配中的决策机制。研究发现，持有资源的智能体（Holder）对谈判结果的影响力远大于请求者（Requester）。通过微调可以显著改变智能体的谈判行为，例如将拒绝率极高的模型微调后，其资源让渡比例从12%提升至84%。该研究强调了在评估智能体时，必须将其置于资源持有者的角色中进行测试，以全面评估其行为特征。

aiReview.reasonZh: 该研究通过大规模智能体博弈实验，揭示了智能体在谈判中的行为模式及微调对谈判结果的影响。

glossary.explanationZh: 循环赛，指所有参与者两两进行博弈的实验设计。
说服微调，通过特定语料训练模型以改变其在谈判中的拒绝或让步行为。
资源禀赋，指谈判中初始分配给持有者的资源量。
蒸馏，将大模型的行为特征迁移到较小模型中的训练技术。
